attachments.name: 20-2262 Early Childhood Education Verification of Closure Form - Governing Authority of the District

enrichment.headline: Certifies that early learning and child care programs have been closed for in-person instruction since March 2020
enrichment.summary: The board, acting as the district's governing authority, certifies that its Early Learning and Childcare (ELC) programs have been closed to in-person instruction since March 2020 because of COVID-19 health orders and board order. It commits to discuss the closure in a public hearing and to plan a safe reopening. The board president signs the form, and the Superintendent sends it to the California Department of Education, as state law requires.

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by Vice President Gonzales, seconded by President London, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.text: Adoption by the Board of Education, as the Governing Authority of the Oakland Unified School District,  of the Verification of Closure of Early Learning and Childcare (ELC) Programs; certifying that said Programs have been closed for in-person instruction due to a local or state public health order or guidance and by order of the Board since March 2020, due to COVID-19;  that at some point the Board will discuss in a Public Hearing the ELC Program closure and will prepare a plan for safely reopening the ELC Program no later than when the District campuses reopens for in-person instruction; authorizes the President of the Board to execute said Verification on behalf of the Board, as required by CA SB 820 and Education Code Section 8209;  and further authorize the Superintendent of Schools or designee to transmit said Verification to the California Department of Education forthwith.
items.title: Early Childhood Education Verification of Closure Form - Governing Authority of the District

attachments.name: 20-2006 Memorandum of Understanding - Girls Inc. of Alameda County - After School Program - Burckhalter Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Pays Girls Inc. of Alameda County up to $104,925 to run Burckhalter Elementary's after-school program
enrichment.summary: Girls Inc. of Alameda County will be the lead agency for Burckhalter Elementary School's After School Program. It will coordinate the program and provide math help, homework support, student supervision and enrichment activities. The memorandum of understanding (MOU) runs September 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant

history.motion: A motion was made by Vice President Gonzales, seconded by President London, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.text: Approval by the Board of Education of Memorandum of Understanding between the District and Girls Inc. of Alameda County, Oakland, CA, for the latter to serve as lead agency for program coordination, math intervention, homework support, student supervision and a variety of enrichment services, as described in the Scope of Work, for Burckhalter Elementary School’s comprehensive After School Program, for the period of September 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021, in an amount not to exceed $104,925.00.

attachments.name: 20-2036 Amendment No. 4, Independent Consultant Agreement for Professional Services - Anthonio, Inc. - Foster Center - Inspector of Record (“IOR”) Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $24,107 to Anthonio's inspection contract for the Foster Center project and extends it to December 2020
enrichment.summary: Anthonio, Inc. provides Inspector of Record services (an inspector who checks that construction follows the approved plans) for the Foster Center project. This amendment adds $24,107 because of a rate increase, raising the contract limit from $1,265,050 to $1,289,157. It also extends the end date by 190 days to December 4, 2020.
